d:
A speeding Thar allegedly ran over a 60-year-old LIC agent in Kanpur. The woman driving the SUV was arrested, but a court rejected the police's request for 14-day judicial custody and ordered her release on a ₹25,000 personal bond. The court questioned the grounds of arrest and the use of the murder charge. Why did the court intervene? Did the police make procedural mistakes?
Production: Akash
Video Editor: Satyam
